newsitem.title: UK: UK watchdog raps Willis Corroon on pensions.
newsitem.headline: UK watchdog raps Willis Corroon on pensions.

text.p: The UK's Investment Management Regulatory Organisation (IMRO) said on Monday it has fined Willis Corroon Financial Planning, the independent financial advice unit of international insurance broker Willis Corroon Plc, 95,000 stg for breaching pension transfer rules.

Willis Corroon, and financial advisers Heath Consulting (formerly C E Heath Financial Services), Alexander Consulting, and Godwins were together fined 405,000 stg by IMRO for failing to provide customers with adequate information, IMRO said.
The four must also pay investigation costs totalling 225,000 stg.
